newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq stocks down at close.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq stocks down at close.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks closed down again on Thursday with many technology issues trading lower on a bout of profit taking.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was down 10.79 points, or 0.82 percent, at 1298.33 while declines led advances by 2195 to 2106 on volume of about 600 million shares.
But Nasdaq had some winners today despite the decline, foremost among them being Boston Technology Inc which closed up 4-3/8 at 23-3/8 in active trading.
The company said it agreed to provide SBC Communication Inc's Southwestern Bell unit with $60 million of hardware, software and services.

Intel Corp was unchanged at 136-7/8 falling back after hitting an intra-day high at 141-1/2 but Microsoft Corp and Dell Computer Corp surrendered yesterday's gains, falling 2-3/8 to 81 and 2-5/8 to 57-1/4, respectively.
Analysts said that profit-taking was inevitable after yesterday's rally in high techs slashed Nasdaq losses and put it within a stone's throw of the upside.
Cisco Systems Inc was down 2-1/4 at 65-3/4.
